Class ScenarioCulturalTensorCatalog

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioCulturalTensorCatalog
public final class ScenarioCulturalTensorCatalog extends Object
Catalog and descriptor registry for multi-dimensional cultural tensors.

Provides localized metadata, parameter descriptors, baseline dataset references, and planetary source suggestions across all cultural dimensions.

Version:
1.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
